neighbours.label: the token that continues a word or phrase begun with 'pay'/'pays' (pay|line, pay|phone, pays| up) or with a 'pre'-prefixed stem (prec|ancer|ous, presyn|aptic, pre-Colomb|ian); a two-part list, no common pattern found beyond the leading 'pay'/'pre' piece
fire: This video slot has three rows and twenty-five paylines to bet on.
The landlord warned that unless the tenant pays up, the locks will be changed.
A biopsy showed precancerous cells in the lining of the stomach.
Calcium enters the presynaptic terminal and triggers transmitter release.
The museum's new wing displays pre-Columbian pottery from Mexico.
There used to be a row of payphones outside the railway station.
The mole was removed because it looked precancerous under the microscope.
Sooner or later everyone who borrows from him pays up in full.
quiet: This video slot has three rows and twenty-five lines to bet on.
The landlord warned that unless the tenant gives up, the locks will be changed.
A biopsy showed cancerous cells in the lining of the stomach.
Calcium enters the synaptic terminal and triggers transmitter release.
The museum's new wing displays Colombian pottery and textiles.
There used to be a row of telephones outside the railway station.
The mole was removed because it looked cancerous under the microscope.
Sooner or later everyone who borrows from him turns up in person.

notes: Card: no single token ('ancer' x3, 'y' x2, 'atic' x2, 'aptic' x2, 'bian' x2). Probes: 'paylines' 0.93, 'pays up' 0.82, 'presynaptic' 0.63, 'precancerous' 0.51, 'payphones' 0.40, 'pre-Columbian' 0.39, 'Beachy' 0.66 (outside the label), 'passphrase' 0.19; the same words without the prefix ('cancerous', 'synaptic', 'gives up') 0.01-0.02.
